prompt_text: I want to try a tanning salon in Charlotte. Which specific salons should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — quick question first so I give useful, accurate picks: do you want UV tanning (beds) or spray/sunless tanning? And what part of Charlotte or ZIP code are you near (Uptown, South End, Ballantyne, University City, etc.)?

If you want to decide quickly, here’s a short plan plus specific places I commonly recommend calling in Charlotte and why — I can pull phone numbers/addresses once you tell me which area you prefer.

Recommended salons (call these types of places)

- Palm Beach Tan (chain)
  - Why call: multiple Charlotte locations, consistent cleanliness and equipment, membership and package options, both high‑pressure and bed options at some locations. Good if you want predictable pricing and service.
- Sun Tan City (chain)
  - Why call: another large chain with multiple locations; often has promotional deals and a variety of bed types. Good for finding multiple nearby locations and walk‑in availability.
- Tan Republic (chain)
  - Why call: often higher‑end beds and packages, modern facilities. Good if you want a more premium salon experience.
- Local boutique spray‑tan studios (search for “spray tan” + your neighborhood on Yelp/Google)
  - Why call: boutique studios typically use professional technicians and offer custom solutions, better color matching, and safer sunless options if you want to avoid UV.
- Gyms with tanning (e.g., Planet Fitness)
  - Why call: cheaper per‑session options if you already use the gym; beds vary widely in quality so call to confirm maintenance and bed type.

What to ask when you call (important questions)
- Do you offer UV beds, spray tanning, or both?
- What specific bed types/brands do you have (high‑pressure vs low‑pressure, stand‑up or lay‑down)?
- Do you provide skin assessments/consultation before first tanning session?
- What solution/brand do you use for spray tans? Do you offer a patch test for first‑timers?
- Are technicians licensed/trained? What sanitation protocols do you follow between clients?
- Pricing and packages (single session, packages, memberships, cancellation policy)
- Do you require/offer goggles, lotion, or prep products?
- Do you have before/after photos or client testimonials?

Red flags to avoid
- No consultation or skin assessment for first‑time tanners
- No sanitation protocol or vague answers about cleaning
- Staff unwilling to explain bed types, solutions, or safety precautions
- Unrealistic promises (“totally safe to overuse beds”)

If you tell me the neighborhood and whether you want UV or spray, I’ll call up-to-date local recommendations and give phone numbers, addresses, and the top reasons to choose each one.
